name: Letush
overview: Letush is a male biblical figure identified primarily as the son of Dedan, as recorded in Genesis 25:3. There is no additional information about his tribe or other distinguishing notes. His mention is brief and focused on his genealogical placement.
namesAndTitles: The name Letush means 'sharpened.' This proper name is not indicated as being given by God but reflects a Hebrew meaning that may imply strength or readiness. The name itself is the only recorded title or designation for this individual.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Letush as the son of Dedan, establishing a direct paternal relationship. Beyond this, there are no other family relationships or connections noted for Letush in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Letush's significance lies in his inclusion in the genealogical record of Genesis, identifying him as a descendant of Dedan. This placement situates him within the broader narrative of the descendants of Abraham, contributing to the biblical understanding of lineage and heritage. Though his role is not expanded upon, his mention preserves the continuity of God's providential unfolding of history.
